title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
slides: Google Photos wants to be your personal stylist?
It scans your photos to build a virtual closet.
But it may not understand your unique style.
Now you can access it on Android and iOS.
Try it and see if it actually helps.
thread_text:
1. Your Photos, Styled?

Google Photos now scans your library to build a virtual closet. It might just become your personal stylist.

2. Closet in the Cloud

The feature pulls clothing items from your photos. No manual tagging needed.

3. A Style Blind Spot

It may not grasp your unique taste. Algorithmic suggestions can miss the mark.

4. Now on Your Phone

Android and iOS users can access it today. The rollout is live.

5. Test It Yourself

Try it on your next outfit photo. Does it actually help, or just add noise?

script: Google Photos wants to be your stylist.

But it may not get your unique style.
Now available on Android and iOS.
Try it and see if it helps.

instagram.caption:
You upload an outfit photo, and Google Photos quietly adds it to a virtual closet. 👗

The feature scans your library and pulls out clothing items automatically — no manual tagging.

But it may misread your taste, so its suggestions can miss the mark.

It's now live on both Android and iOS.

If you post outfit content, your camera roll just became a styling tool you didn't ask for. 📸

Open the app and check if your closet already exists — does it actually get your style, or just guess? 🤔
